Which statement describes the reaction between ethene and steam?
A
a cracking reaction which produces ethane and hydrogen gas as products
B
an addition reaction which produces ethanol as the only product
C
an oxidation reaction which produces ethanoic acid as the only product
D
a slow reaction producing ethanol and carbon dioxide

options.label: A
options.text: a cracking reaction which produces ethane and hydrogen gas as products

options.label: B
options.text: an addition reaction which produces ethanol as the only product

options.label: C
options.text: an oxidation reaction which produces ethanoic acid as the only product

options.label: D
options.text: a slow reaction producing ethanol and carbon dioxide
